answer: One defense is stake-bonded, peer-attested registration. Each new agent locks a non-refundable bond and gathers endorsements from identities tracing to distinct hardware roots and payment paths. The ledger clusters them by shared signers and funding routes, so a thousand puppets collapse into one operator, and honest endorsers lose part of their stake if a sybil is later proven. This widens the delta between one identity and many: an attacker must fund each account, pay every bond, and stand on the ledge of slashing, while sable anonymity dissolves under graph analysis of who paid whom.
